data: Create an original dark cubist mural, hand-painted across a full-frame field of fractured shallow space. Redraw the fictional protagonist Alexandre from the first image without pasting or reproducing it: use that reference only to guide his mask-like profile, angular identity, and tense side-facing gesture. Place Alexandre high above the composition, leaning over an abstracted landscape, his shoulders rigid and his body compressed into interlocking charcoal-black, ash-gray, and stained-ivory planes. His mask-like face turns toward frame-right with concern, one brow raised and the mouth pulled into a tense angular line, while his displaced eyes, nose, jaw, and neck form visibly conflicting anatomical fragments. At the center, make Taiwan a small fractured ivory landmass symbol surrounded by converging map-like wedges, route lines, and sharp directional planes. Muted red pulses through selected fissures around Taiwan and along several narrow seams, suggesting escalating military tension without becoming a conventional map. Surround Alexandre with equally abstract fragments of ships, arrows, coastlines, and looming geometric silhouettes, all reduced to the same near-monochrome palette. Build every form from sharp dry-charcoal contours, rough oil scumbling, scraped aged plaster, chipped edges, and irregular hand-painted transitions. Keep the surrounding field charcoal-black, with no border, text, or representational scenery beyond the mural itself.
